City id bart is a SEPARATE city. Do not invent city=sf, city=san-francisco, city=bay-area, city=oakland, or city=sfo. Do not merge into chicago or washington. Agency BART. Modes v1: BART heavy rail (five color lines) plus OAK Airport because the printed BART service legend lists it as a BART line (Coliseum–Oakland Int’l Airport). No Muni Metro, no Muni bus, no Caltrain, no ACE, no Capitol Corridor, no SMART, no ferry, no VTA.

City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Cut #1 is Rotterdam only. Chicago stays planned and untouched. Washington stays planned and untouched. This pack stays planned. assertCityLive("bart") must fail.
Timezone America/Los_Angeles HAS DST (PDT/PST). Do not copy Perth / Brisbane no-DST.

Five printed color lines on the current map plus OAK Airport in the same BART service legend: Yellow, Blue, Green, Red, Orange, OAK. mapGroup BART. Conventional ETD color tokens YELLOW/BLUE/GREEN/RED/ORANGE recorded as gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown (from ETD docs, not extracted from GTFS). OAK has no ETD color token on the ETD page.

Locked inner-city printed name: Embarcadero (first downtown SF stop after the Transbay Tube; Yellow/Blue/Green/Red). The map prints Embarcadero, Montgomery St, Powell St, Civic Center/UN Plaza as an equal four-stop downtown SF trunk — not a single named transfer diamond. Powell St is the Muni/cable-car-famous stop; do not mix Muni; do not steal the lock. Orange never calls Embarcadero (East Bay only). Embarcadero is a stop string, not a direction token.

50 unique passenger BART stops after shared-transfer dedupe (same physical nest counted once). Official stations index also lists 50 including Oakland International Airport. No same-name different-line places. Irvington (PLANNED FUTURE STATION) and Phase II 28th St/Little Portugal / Downtown San José / Diridon / Santa Clara are Future Service — not inserted. No 2026 opening is printed as open on this map.

Berryessa/North San José (map, accent, no spaces) vs Berryessa / North San Jose (stations). 16th St Mission / 24th St Mission (map, no period) vs 16th St. Mission / 24th St. Mission. Civic Center/UN Plaza (map) vs Civic Center / UN Plaza. San Francisco International Airport (SFO) and Oakland International Airport (OAK) keep the map airport codes.

Yellow: daytime legend Antioch–SFO Int’l Airport; evening legend Antioch–Millbrae; dashed yellow SFO–Millbrae; TRAIN CONTROL MODERNIZATION note After 9pm, change trains at SFO for Millbrae service. stations[] is Antioch→SFO then Millbrae. eBART Antioch + Pittsburg Center print as Yellow (not a sixth color). Change trains at transfer platform east of Pittsburg/Bay Point is not a named passenger station.

Red: map legend Richmond–Millbrae. Red does not enter the SFO spur on this map (Yellow does). Weekend timetable file is Richmond to Millbrae +SFO — H3 overlay, not a Red station-list row. Map still wins.

Green and Blue skip 12th St/Oakland City Center and 19th St/Oakland (West Oakland ↔ Lake Merritt). Orange skips West Oakland and all of San Francisco (12th St ↔ Lake Merritt). Red and Yellow skip Lake Merritt (12th St ↔ West Oakland).

OAK Airport is the gray BART-to-OAK automated people-mover, listed in the BART service legend with a plane icon (not an R/O/Y/G/B color block). Included because the printed official map lists it as a BART line. No PDF timetable. No real-time ETD. Average wait 4.5 minutes per schedules/pdfs.

printedInnerCityNames.lockNote: Printed inner-city lock. First downtown San Francisco stop after the Transbay Tube on the official BART map. Yellow, Blue, Green, and Red all call here. The map prints Embarcadero / Montgomery St / Powell St / Civic Center/UN Plaza as an equal four-stop downtown SF trunk, not a single named transfer diamond. Powell St is not the lock (Muni/cable-car mix). Orange never serves Embarcadero. Inbound/outbound dies at Embarcadero (through-run to East Bay or Peninsula). Embarcadero is a stop string, not a direction token.

coverageGaps: Muni Metro (J Church, N Judah, T Third, L Taraval, K Ingleside, M Ocean View, F Market & Wharves). Gray connecting rail on the detailed map. Out of v1.
Muni bus / cable car. Out of v1. Powell St Muni mix is why Powell is not the hub lock.
Caltrain (Millbrae transfer; 22nd St, Bayshore, Peninsula stations). Transfer, not a D1 stop. doNotGroup Millbrae vs Caltrain Millbrae.
ACE (crosses near Fremont / Union City toward Pleasanton / Livermore). Out of v1.
Capitol Corridor / Amtrak San Joaquins (Richmond, Coliseum, Antioch-Pittsburg Amtrak). Transfers, not D1 stops.
SMART / Larkspur / San Rafael. Out of v1.
VTA light rail (Milpitas / Alum Rock; San José). Out of v1.
Irvington (PLANNED FUTURE STATION) between Fremont and Warm Springs/South Fremont. Not inserted.
Silicon Valley Phase II Future Service: 28th St/Little Portugal, Downtown San José, Diridon, Santa Clara. Not inserted.
No 2026 station opening is printed as open on this map.
